description: #791 referenced counterparts (the #780 class): a TypeScript port names its v2 source file on an added line. The anchors are the real change_anchors output for source_diff over repo_files (pinned by tests/test_change_anchors.py): declarations whose normalized names match (`buildPrMetadata` / `_build_pr_metadata`) become counterparts, the body the diff also touches first and marked ref_changed, the body the diff adds in full skipped, and the missing referenced file ignored. Both scanners render the bounded bodies.
